text:
Based on my personal experience, I've been undergoing orthodontic treatment here for almost 6 years, and I've changed doctors twice, with 3 different doctors.
The first doctor change was due to conflicting schedules and distance, but the first doctor was excellent; I commend them.
The second doctor, who continued my case, took impressions but didn't consider anything, saying they didn't want anything done because they were going to further their studies and wanted to finish the case easily. However, they didn't stay to finish the case, leaving the impressions unfinished. In the end, I didn't have my braces removed because my teeth shifted, but I had already paid for the retainers. The reason the doctor wasn't there on the scheduled removal date was that they didn't have one. The cleaning lady said the doctor wasn't there and asked why I didn't call beforehand. It was the patient's fault for coming to the appointment as scheduled. The clinic apologized and passed the case on to another doctor.
The third doctor offered a free pair of retainers. Now, I'm about to have my braces removed, and I asked the clinic what was included in the course I paid for. They replied that it included a free home whitening kit and one pair of retainers. They also explained that orthodontic treatment isn't something the doctor checks to see if you're ready to have your braces removed; the patient has to decide for themselves whether they want to remove them. Perhaps because it was a case referred to them, they didn't provide proper care. In short, this clinic hasn't resolved any problems at all. The management is like children's play, and the staff are rude. I went to the second doctor's appointment, and the staff forgot to send the chart information to the doctor's room. Then, we chatted for so long that people who came after us were able to get their service done first. When we asked about it, the staff said they forgot and told us to wait. We complained, and the female staff member (who looked like a tomboy) retorted, "What do you want, customer?" She had absolutely no service mind and was incredibly unwelcoming. Think carefully before choosing this place; it might be cheaper elsewhere, but it's definitely worse. Giving it one star is too much for the experience.
